minimumAge.notes: Must hold LMV license for at least 1 year

documents: Proof of age (Birth certificate / 10th marksheet / Passport)
Proof of address (Aadhaar Card / Passport / Utility bill)
Medical certificate (Form 1-A) from registered medical practitioner
Valid Learner License (at least 30 days old, not expired)
Proof of age and address (same as LL)
Training certificate from registered driving school (recommended)

licenseProcess.title: Apply for Learner License Online
licenseProcess.description: Visit the Sarathi portal, fill Form 2, upload documents, pay the fee (Rs 200), and book a slot at your nearest RTO.

licenseProcess.title: Pass the Learner License Test
licenseProcess.description: Appear at the RTO on your booked date. Take the computer-based multiple choice test on traffic rules and signs. You need to score at least 9 out of 15.

licenseProcess.title: Practice Driving (Mandatory Wait)
licenseProcess.description: After receiving your Learner License, practice driving for at least 30 days. Enrolling in a registered driving school is highly recommended for structured training.

licenseProcess.title: Apply for Permanent License & Book Driving Test
licenseProcess.description: Apply online via Sarathi after 30 days (but before LL expires at 6 months). Pay the fee (Rs 300) and book your driving test slot at the RTO.

licenseProcess.title: Pass the Driving Test
licenseProcess.description: Appear at the RTO with a vehicle for the practical test. The examiner will test your driving skills including road maneuvers, signaling, and traffic rule compliance. On passing, your Permanent Driving License is issued.

fees.notes: Apply before expiry to avoid late fee

tips: Book your LL test slot for early morning — RTOs are less crowded before 11 AM.
Carry original documents plus one photocopy set to the RTO.
Practice on the actual test track near your RTO if possible — each RTO has slightly different layouts.
A driving school certificate can speed up the DL process and improve your test confidence.
Apply for your permanent license as soon as the 30-day wait is over — don't let the LL expire.
